story.title: The Fall of the Old King

narrator.persona: a calm, warm storyteller, like a nature documentary narrator who is quietly afraid

sentences.text: The tyrant lizard reigned over the ancient fern forests while the night sky looked completely ordinary.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Long necked herbivores grazed peacefully beside rushing rivers while a strange extra star flickered above.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Suddenly that bright star split into a thousand pieces and heavy burning rocks rained down upon the canopy.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Fireballs crashed into the lowlands and every living creature fled in blind panic from the approaching heat.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Deep inside the smoking impact crater something massive shifted beneath the glowing meteorite fragment.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: An impossible silhouette rose from the rubble bearing violet eyes that had never seen our sun.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The old king roared a final challenge before the darkness swallowed his voice entirely.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Now a foreign shadow rules these lands and who could survive what fell from the stars?
sentences.speaker: narrator
